name: NO10_1270N
variant: Tata Steel / Surahammars Hi-Lite NO10-1270N, 0.1 mm, fully processed

provenance.source: Tata Steel Hi-Lite datasheet NO10-1270N (Mar 2019), docs/sources/materials/tata_hi-lite_no10-1270n.pdf, p. 2 'Typical peak magnetic polarisation (magnetisation curve)', 50 Hz column (the 50, 100 and 200 Hz columns agree to 0.01-0.02 T at these thicknesses, so 50 Hz stands in for DC). Stored as B = J + mu0 H. Typical, not guaranteed; guaranteed minima on p. 1 (J at 2500/5000/10000 A/m).

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the Hi-Lite datasheet gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: PROVISIONAL: typical value for high-silicon non-oriented steel (resistivity 51 uOhm cm); the datasheet states no Js
density_source: Hi-Lite datasheet NO10-1270N p. 1: density (assumed) 7.65 kg/dm3
